@@ -0,0 +1,285 @@

+
+import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivSchemeHighWindowStage
+import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivSchemeHighWindowPersistence
+import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivSchemeSeedUnivSecondWindowBaseChange
+
+/-!
+# Recursive relation modules in every high divisor-scheme window
+
+This file constructs the relative relation tower generated by the multiplier window.
+The initial relation module is the universal first carve window.  Its first successor
+reuses the already-landed finite universal multiplication span, transported to high-window
+index one.  Every later successor is the range of the analogous finite basis-indexed
+multiplication map.
+
+Only finite generation is asserted.  In particular, no high relation module is assumed
+to be a Grassmannian point, projective, pure, or to have flat quotient; those are the
+scheme-theoretic persistence obligations which remain after this formal recursion.
+-/
+
+set_option autoImplicit false
+set_option quotPrecheck false
+set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
+set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 8
+set_option maxRecDepth 8000
+-- Recurrence declarations deliberately retain the standing curve pack through their ambients.
+set_option linter.unusedSectionVars false
+
+universe u
+
+open CategoryTheory Limits TopologicalSpace Opposite
+open scoped TensorProduct
+
+namespace AlgebraicGeometry
+
+open Scheme Grassmannian
+
+attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra
+  Scheme.functionFieldOverModule
+attribute [local instance 10000] relCurve.instOver
+
+section HighWindowRelations
+
+variable {k : Type u} [Field k] (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
+  [hSmoothC : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [hProperC : IsProper C.hom]
+  [hGeometricallyIrreducibleC : GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
+variable {pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsFinite pi] [IsDominant pi]
+
+noncomputable local instance instOverCleftHighWindowRelations :
+    C.left.Over (Spec (.of k)) := ⟨C.hom⟩
+
+variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (C.left ↘ Spec (.of k))] [IsIntegral C.left]
+  [LocallyOfFiniteType (C.left ↘ Spec (.of k))]
+  [QuasiCompact (C.left ↘ Spec (.of k))]
+variable [Module.Finite k (Sheaf.HModule (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) 0)]
+  [Module.Finite k (Sheaf.HModule (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) 1)]
+variable (hpi : pi ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
+variable (g r1 r2 : Nat)
+variable (b1 : Module.Basis (Fin r1) k
+  ↥(Scheme.divisorSections k (windowM_choice pi hpi g • fiberWeilDivisor pi) ⊤))
+variable (b2 : Module.Basis (Fin r2) k
+  ↥(Scheme.divisorSections k ((windowS_choice pi hpi g • fiberWeilDivisor pi)
+    + (windowM_choice pi hpi g • fiberWeilDivisor pi)) ⊤))
+variable (i : (glueData k g r1).J) (j : (glueData k g r2).J)
+
+local notation "RZ" => DivCarveChartRing k
+  (windowS_choice pi hpi g • fiberWeilDivisor pi)
+  (windowM_choice pi hpi g • fiberWeilDivisor pi) g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j
+local notation "HS" => ↥(Scheme.divisorSections k
+  (windowS_choice pi hpi g • fiberWeilDivisor pi) ⊤)
+
+/-! ## The arbitrary successor multiplication map -/
+
+/-- Reindex the product divisor `sF + (M + n*s)F` as the next high window. -/
+noncomputable def divUniversalHighWindowSuccEquiv (n : Nat) :
+    ↥(Scheme.divisorSections k
+        ((windowS_choice pi hpi g • fiberWeilDivisor pi) +
+          (divUniversalHighWindowExponent (C := C) (pi := pi) hpi g n •
+            fiberWeilDivisor pi)) ⊤) ≃ₗ[k]
+      divUniversalHighWindowSections (C := C) (pi := pi) hpi g (n + 1) :=
+  LinearEquiv.ofEq _ _ (congrArg (fun D => Scheme.divisorSections k D ⊤) (by
+    rw [← add_nsmul]
+    apply congrArg (fun m : Nat => m • fiberWeilDivisor pi)
+    simp only [divUniversalHighWindowExponent, Nat.succ_mul]
+    omega))
+
+/-- Multiplication by one multiplier-basis section from high window `n` to `n+1`. -/
+noncomputable def divUniversalHighWindowShiftMul (n : Nat) (a : HS) :
+    divUniversalHighWindowSections (C := C) (pi := pi) hpi g n →ₗ[k]
+      divUniversalHighWindowSections (C := C) (pi := pi) hpi g (n + 1) :=
+  (divUniversalHighWindowSuccEquiv (C := C) (pi := pi) hpi g n).toLinearMap.comp
+    (sectionMulBilin k
+      (windowS_choice pi hpi g • fiberWeilDivisor pi)
+      (divUniversalHighWindowExponent (C := C) (pi := pi) hpi g n •
+        fiberWeilDivisor pi) a)
+
+/-- The finite tuple source used to span the successor of a relation module `K`. -/
+noncomputable abbrev DivUniversalHighWindowMulSource (n : Nat)
+    (K : Submodule RZ
+      (divUniversalHighWindowAmbient (C := C) (pi := pi) (hpi := hpi) (g := g)
+        (r1 := r1) (r2 := r2) (b1 := b1) (b2 := b2) (i := i) (j := j) n)) :
+    Type u :=
+  Fin (Module.finrank k HS) → ↥K
+
+set_option maxHeartbeats 1600000 in
+-- Elaborating the nested base change and dependent high-window ambient exceeds the default budget.
+/-- The finite basis-indexed multiplication map carrying `K_n` into window `n+1`. -/
+noncomputable def divUniversalHighWindowMulMap (n : Nat)
+    (K : Submodule RZ
+      (divUniversalHighWindowAmbient (C := C) (pi := pi) (hpi := hpi) (g := g)
+        (r1 := r1) (r2 := r2) (b1 := b1) (b2 := b2) (i := i) (j := j) n)) :
+    DivUniversalHighWindowMulSource (C := C) (pi := pi)
+        hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j n K →ₗ[RZ]
+      divUniversalHighWindowAmbient (C := C) (pi := pi) (hpi := hpi) (g := g)
+        (r1 := r1) (r2 := r2) (b1 := b1) (b2 := b2) (i := i) (j := j) (n + 1) :=
+  ∑ t : Fin (Module.finrank k HS),
+    (LinearMap.baseChange RZ
+      (divUniversalHighWindowShiftMul (C := C) (pi := pi) hpi g n
+        ((Module.finBasis k HS) t))).comp
+      (K.subtype.comp (LinearMap.proj t))
+
+/-- The successor relation module: the finite `RZ`-linear multiplication span of `K`. -/
+noncomputable def divUniversalHighWindowMulSpan (n : Nat)
+    (K : Submodule RZ
+      (divUniversalHighWindowAmbient (C := C) (pi := pi) (hpi := hpi) (g := g)
+        (r1 := r1) (r2 := r2) (b1 := b1) (b2 := b2) (i := i) (j := j) n)) :
+    Submodule RZ
+      (divUniversalHighWindowAmbient (C := C) (pi := pi) (hpi := hpi) (g := g)
+        (r1 := r1) (r2 := r2) (b1 := b1) (b2 := b2) (i := i) (j := j) (n + 1)) :=
+  LinearMap.range
+    (divUniversalHighWindowMulMap (C := C) (pi := pi)
+      hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j n K)
+
+set_option synthInstance.maxHeartbeats 400000 in
+-- Finiteness inference unfolds the dependent finite tuple source.
+/-- A successor multiplication source is finite when its input relation module is finite. -/
+theorem finite_divUniversalHighWindowMulSource (n : Nat)
+    (K : Submodule RZ
+      (divUniversalHighWindowAmbient (C := C) (pi := pi) (hpi := hpi) (g := g)
+        (r1 := r1) (r2 := r2) (b1 := b1) (b2 := b2) (i := i) (j := j) n))
+    [Module.Finite RZ ↥K] :
+    Module.Finite RZ
+      (DivUniversalHighWindowMulSource (C := C) (pi := pi)
+        hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j n K) := by
+  infer_instance
+
+set_option maxHeartbeats 1600000 in
+-- Reducing the dependent range and its base-changed map exceeds the default budget.
+set_option synthInstance.maxHeartbeats 400000 in
+-- The range instance combines source finiteness with the dependent multiplication map.
+/-- The finite multiplication span of a finite relation module is finite. -/
+theorem finite_divUniversalHighWindowMulSpan (n : Nat)
+    (K : Submodule RZ
+      (divUniversalHighWindowAmbient (C := C) (pi := pi) (hpi := hpi) (g := g)
+        (r1 := r1) (r2 := r2) (b1 := b1) (b2 := b2) (i := i) (j := j) n))
+    [Module.Finite RZ ↥K] :
+    Module.Finite RZ
+      ↥(divUniversalHighWindowMulSpan (C := C) (pi := pi)
+        hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j n K) := by
+  letI := finite_divUniversalHighWindowMulSource
+    (C := C) (pi := pi) hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j n K
+  infer_instance
+
+/-! ## The recursive relation tower -/
+
+set_option maxHeartbeats 1600000 in
+-- The recursive ambient changes with the index and requires extended definitional reduction.
+/-- The recursive high-window relation modules.
+
+Stage zero is the universal first window.  Stage one is the already-landed universal
+multiplication span transported to the high-window ambient.  From stage one onward the
+successor is formed by `divUniversalHighWindowMulSpan`. -/
+noncomputable def divUniversalHighWindowRelation :
+    (n : Nat) → Submodule RZ
+      (divUniversalHighWindowAmbient (C := C) (pi := pi) (hpi := hpi) (g := g)
+        (r1 := r1) (r2 := r2) (b1 := b1) (b2 := b2) (i := i) (j := j) n)
+  | 0 => (divUniversalHighWindowStageZero (C := C) (pi := pi)
+      hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j).toSubmodule
+  | 1 => Submodule.map
+      (LinearMap.baseChange RZ
+        (divUniversalHighWindowOneEquiv (C := C) (pi := pi) hpi g).toLinearMap)
+      (universalMulSpan (C := C) (π := pi) hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j)
+  | n + 2 => divUniversalHighWindowMulSpan (C := C) (pi := pi)
+      hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j (n + 1)
+      (divUniversalHighWindowRelation (n + 1))
+
+set_option maxHeartbeats 1600000 in
+-- Reducing the stage-zero dependent ambient exceeds the default definitional-equality budget.
+@[simp]
+theorem divUniversalHighWindowRelation_zero :
+    divUniversalHighWindowRelation (C := C) (pi := pi)
+      hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j 0 =
+      (divUniversalHighWindowStageZero (C := C) (pi := pi)
+        hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j).toSubmodule :=
+  rfl
+
+set_option maxHeartbeats 1600000 in
+-- Reducing the transported stage-one ambient exceeds the default definitional-equality budget.
+@[simp]
+theorem divUniversalHighWindowRelation_one_transport :
+    divUniversalHighWindowRelation (C := C) (pi := pi)
+      hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j 1 =
+      Submodule.map
+        (LinearMap.baseChange RZ
+          (divUniversalHighWindowOneEquiv (C := C) (pi := pi) hpi g).toLinearMap)
+        (universalMulSpan (C := C) (π := pi) hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j) :=
+  rfl
+
+@[simp]
+theorem divUniversalHighWindowRelation_succ_succ (n : Nat) :
+    divUniversalHighWindowRelation (C := C) (pi := pi)
+      hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j (n + 2) =
+      divUniversalHighWindowMulSpan (C := C) (pi := pi)
+        hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j (n + 1)
+        (divUniversalHighWindowRelation (C := C) (pi := pi)
+          hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j (n + 1)) :=
+  rfl
+
+set_option maxHeartbeats 1600000 in
+-- The recursive ambient changes with the index and requires extended definitional reduction.
+set_option synthInstance.maxHeartbeats 400000 in
+-- Successor finiteness repeatedly unfolds the dependent range instance.
+/-- Every recursively generated relation module is finite over `RZ`. -/
+theorem finite_divUniversalHighWindowRelation :
+    ∀ n : Nat, Module.Finite RZ
+      ↥(divUniversalHighWindowRelation (C := C) (pi := pi)
+        hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j n)
+  | 0 => by
+      let x := divUniversalHighWindowStageZero (C := C) (pi := pi)
+        hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j
+      letI := finite_divUniversalHighWindowQuotient
+        (C := C) (pi := pi) hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j 0 x
+      letI := projective_divUniversalHighWindowQuotient
+        (C := C) (pi := pi) hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j 0 x
+      exact finite_submodule_of_projective_quotient x.toSubmodule
+  | 1 => by
+      letI := finite_universalMulSpan (C := C) (π := pi)
+        hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j
+      infer_instance
+  | n + 2 => by
+      letI := finite_divUniversalHighWindowRelation (n + 1)
+      exact finite_divUniversalHighWindowMulSpan
+        (C := C) (pi := pi) hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j (n + 1)
+          (divUniversalHighWindowRelation (C := C) (pi := pi)
+            hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j (n + 1))
+
+/-! ## Agreement with the two landed universal windows -/
+
+set_option maxHeartbeats 1600000 in
+-- Expanding stage zero compares two dependent tensor-product ambients.
+/-- Stage zero, expanded all the way to the transported universal first window. -/
+theorem divUniversalHighWindowRelation_zero_eq_firstWindow :
+    divUniversalHighWindowRelation (C := C) (pi := pi)
+      hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j 0 =
+      Submodule.map
+        (LinearMap.baseChange RZ
+          (divUniversalHighWindowZeroEquiv (C := C) (pi := pi) hpi g).toLinearMap)
+        (divUniversalFstWindow C pi hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j).toSubmodule := by
+  rw [divUniversalHighWindowRelation_zero,
+    divUniversalHighWindowStageZero_toSubmodule]
+
+set_option maxHeartbeats 1600000 in
+-- Comparing the two transported second-window ambients is definitionally expensive.
+/-- Under the landed relative persistence hypotheses, stage one is exactly the
+transported universal second window. -/
+theorem divUniversalHighWindowRelation_one_eq_secondWindow
+    (hO : Sheaf.h0 (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) = 1)
+    (hchi : Sheaf.chi (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) = 1 - (g : Int))
+    (hb : 0 < windowBound pi hpi) :
+    divUniversalHighWindowRelation (C := C) (pi := pi)
+      hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j 1 =
+      (divUniversalHighWindowStageOne (C := C) (pi := pi)
+        hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j).toSubmodule := by
+  rw [divUniversalHighWindowRelation_one_transport,
+    universalMulSpan_eq_divUniversalSndWindow
+      (C := C) (pi := pi) hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j hO hchi hb,
+    divUniversalHighWindowStageOne_toSubmodule]
+
+end HighWindowRelations
+
+end AlgebraicGeometry
